name: Junior Merit (Class - 11 To 12)
benefit:
1. The students pursuing Class XI & XII in the Higher Secondary Schools of the State will receive a scholarship amount of ₹3000/- per year.
1. The number of scholarships will be awarded to 10,000 students (Boys & Girls in 50:50 ratio).
_eligibility_text:
1. The student must be a permanent resident of Odisha State.
1. The Student must have passed HSC with 60% or more marks from an institution recognized by BSE Odisha, CBSE, ICSE, or Equivalent Boards, and pursuing regular Class XI courses of 10+2.
1. The income of the parents of the students from all sources should not exceed ₹6.00 lakh per annum.
1. Students shall apply for Junior Merit Scholarship in the 1st year of the course (Class XI).
1. The students belong to General, SC, ST, OBC/SEBC & EBC categories may eligible to apply.
